topography.project_purpose: Maverick Protocol is a decentralized exchange (DEX) that offers automated market-making with dynamic fee distribution and liquidity management. It enables users to provide liquidity in customizable pools, earn trading fees, and participate in governance through its native token and voting escrow system.
topography.relationship_narrative: Maverick V1 and V2 share the same governance token (MaverickToken) and voting escrow (VotingEscrow) across chains. V2 introduces new factory and router contracts for reward management, while V1's core AMM logic (PoolPositionManager, PoolInformation) remains foundational on earlier deployments.
